selected_evidence.summary: Direct checks show timezone=America/Toronto and /etc/localtime resolving to /usr/share/zoneinfo/America/Toronto before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID d4784d1b-162e-4faa-b581-f6427617d23c was captured; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID ba4db6ba-50dc-4aa1-958a-1c3bb4e9e78a proves restart; post-restart checks show system_state=running, chronyd=active, and the timezone persisted.

commands.command: printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; timedatectl status; printf 'localtime='; readlink -f /etc/localtime; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true
